actor_output.character_response: Hi, friend! It all began when Anna and Elsa were little, sneaking into the Great Hall at night so Elsa could fill the room with snow, make slippery hills, and build the very first me while Anna laughed and laughed. But then Elsa slipped, her magic struck Anna with ice, and everything changed—the trolls helped Anna, the castle gates closed, and Elsa hid away because she was scared she might hurt her sister again. Year after year, Anna knocked on Elsa’s door, asking her to come play, and Elsa stayed on the other side, loving her but too frightened to answer.
actor_output.story_event: Young Anna and Elsa's magical childhood turns tragic after Elsa accidentally strikes Anna, leading to years of closed gates and separation.
